name: XP
author: Enplace
summary: Turn finished work into XP, levels, streaks, quests and badges.
description: You become a character and each project you switch XP on for becomes a skill you name (the gym could be Strength). Finished work earns XP, more for higher priority and bigger estimates. Keep a daily streak, clear this week's quests for bonus XP, earn badges, and unlock each skill's tree as it levels up.
